A trajectory shift pattern holds when there exists a time or event τ such that the behavior of v(e, m, t) differs before and after τ. Let g_pre denote the trend of v(e, m, t) before τ, and let g_post denote the trend of v(e, m, t) after τ. A trajectory shift holds when: g_pre ≠ g_post or more strongly, |g_post - g_pre| > ε, where ε is a threshold for meaningful change.
